lines.text: In this town, the taller you are, the more power you get.
Me? Four foot one. I walk behind the bus.
And our mayor? Nine feet tall. Nobody has ever told him no.
But something about him was off.
Once, a dog sniffed him... and the coat sneezed.
And his coat... has six shoes.
Your knee is in my ear.
So at his big speech... I made my move.

Turns out the top spot was open.
Every Tuesday, we swap who's on the bottom.

Would you expose them... or join them?
